text.p: BankBoston said it completed the sale of both of its branches in Haiti for undisclosed terms.

BankBoston said the branches, located in Port-au-Prince, were sold to a group of Haitian and American investors including Hamilton Bank N.A. and the general manager of BankBoston's Haiti operations, Guy Cuvilly.
The new bank will operate under the name Banque Intercontinentale de Commerce, S.A.

"The sale of our Haiti operation reflects BankBoston's continued focus on those businesses which provide the corporation's shareholders with high returns," said Mark MacLennan, group executive of global financial services. "While we've benefitted from our stay in Haiti, our continued presence in that market is not in line with our strategic plan for Latin America and the sale allows us to allocate capital to other more profitable businesses.
